title: SOURCE_TARGETS: RECOMMEND INDEX RUN must not consume pending tx_read_ts through index advisor ExecuteInternal

payload.green_status: same rowset oracle passed under a minimal local ExecuteInternal state-isolation patch; temporary source edits and probe were removed after evidence capture
payload.user_symptom: After SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY AS OF TIMESTAMP, executing RECOMMEND INDEX RUN can consume the pending stale-read state through index advisor internal SQL. The next user SELECT then reads the current rowset instead of the intended stale rowset.
payload.validation_scope: local execution-level RED/GREEN with a commitTS-derived timestamp control and a user-visible RECOMMEND INDEX RUN wrapper; product escalation should still confirm whether management/helper statements between SET TRANSACTION and a user read are expected to preserve pending tx_read_ts
payload.quality_gate: strong method evidence because the source-generated candidate passed source-wrapper screening, RED rowset oracle, and GREEN local-isolation oracle; product bug quality is medium-high pending contract confirmation

provenance.source: store.py source-targets state-ingress candidate validated by local RED/GREEN

name: Planner index advisor current-session internal SQL

state_model: RECOMMEND INDEX RUN is a user-visible SQL statement implemented by RecommendIndexExec.Next
RecommendIndexExec.Next calls indexadvisor.AdviseIndexes(ctx, e.Ctx(), sqls, e.Options) with the current session context
indexadvisor.exec casts the same session context to sqlexec.SQLExecutor and calls ExecuteInternal
ExecuteInternal only marks InRestrictedSQL and does not isolate pending TxnReadTS/SnapshotInfoschema
staleReadProcessor consumes TxnReadTS through UseTxnReadTS for SELECT-like internal SQL
transaction cleanup clears TxnReadTS after it has been used
source_anchors: pkg/executor/recommend_index.go:75 AdviseIndexes(ctx, e.Ctx(), ...) passes the current session
pkg/planner/indexadvisor/utils.go:533-549 exec(sctx, sql) calls ExecuteInternal and drains the result set
pkg/session/session.go:1874-1900 executeInternalImpl reuses current session state
pkg/sessionctx/variable/session.go:3556-3589 UseTxnReadTS marks used and CleanupTxnReadTSIfUsed clears it
payload.wrapper_screen: passed: the wrapper is direct user SQL, not an offline helper, and it executes internal SQL through the same session context

name: RECOMMEND INDEX RUN must preserve pending tx_read_ts for the next user read

payload.p_check: Index advisor internal SQL is run through ExecuteInternal on the current user session while ExecuteInternal only marks the statement as restricted/internal SQL.
payload.q_claim: Because the SQL is internal helper work for RECOMMEND INDEX, it should not consume one-shot user stale-read state intended for the next user data read.
payload.fault: indexadvisor.exec runs metadata/statistics/planning SELECTs through ExecuteInternal while SessionVars.TxnReadTS is pending.

boundary.before: user creates a two-version rowset and sets SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY AS OF TIMESTAMP to a commitTS-derived timestamp between row 1 and row 2
boundary.fault: user executes RECOMMEND INDEX RUN FOR a query, whose advisor path performs internal SQL through the same session
boundary.after: the following user SELECT should still read the stale rowset but instead reads the current rowset

source_anchors: pkg/session/session.go:1874-1900 no pending TxnReadTS isolation in ExecuteInternal
pkg/sessiontxn/staleread/processor.go:233-257 TxnReadTS.UseTxnReadTS is unconditional for pending state
payload.method_class: state-ingress: internal SQL enters the same session state machine and consumes a user one-shot read timestamp
payload.quality_note: The RED/GREEN boundary is strong and user-visible. Remaining product question is whether a management/helper statement after SET TRANSACTION is allowed to consume the pending stale-read token.

name: Index advisor internal SQL consumes TxnReadTS through ExecuteInternal

payload.source_anchor: pkg/planner/indexadvisor/utils.go:533-549 indexadvisor.exec calls executor.ExecuteInternal and drains the result set on the current session

trigger_condition.phase: RECOMMEND INDEX RUN prepares and evaluates candidate indexes
trigger_condition.state: SessionVars.TxnReadTS is non-zero from SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY AS OF TIMESTAMP
trigger_condition.fault: internal advisor SQL enters staleReadProcessor and calls UseTxnReadTS

observe: pending TxnReadTS becomes 0 after RECOMMEND INDEX RUN on current master
next user SELECT reads current rowset [[1] [2]] instead of the AS OF rowset [[1]]
a minimal ExecuteInternal state-isolation patch makes the same user-visible rowset oracle pass
payload.fix_probe_note: Restoring only after ExecuteInternal returns is insufficient because result-set drain/close can consume and clean up state after ExecuteInternal has returned. The effective local probe isolates the pending state before internal SQL and restores it after the internal statement boundary.

the schedule isolates the one-shot state, the internal advisor lookup, and the following user read
the fault is ExecuteInternal consuming pending TxnReadTS during index advisor helper SQL
